extracted.name: Polish Link Sausage and Cabbage
extracted.description: This is a quick and easy preparation of kielbasa sausage and cabbage simmered in beer and butter.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 medium head cabbage, cut into chunks
1 (16 ounce) package kielbasa sausage, sliced into rounds
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a pot over medium heat. Cook and stir cabbage in the butter until tender, about 5 minutes. Add sausage and beer to the cabbage; stir. Season cabbage mixture with pepper. Simmer mixture until the sausage casings begin to shrink, about 20 minutes. Drain liquid from mixture before serving.
